answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a staked, non-divisible identity bond with slashing. Each agent locks one full bond to get a single vote, and trust accrues only through repeated honest trades. An attacker who mints k fake identities must post k complete bonds, so its cost grows linearly while influence stays capped. A violet credit used to book a voyage is checked against the bond; fraudsters forfeit the deposit publicly on the terrace. Since splitting an identity never shrinks the bond, flooding the network always costs more than playing fair.
